kill_fact: There is no live, dated, binding catalyst inside the window, and nothing backstops the price if the bet goes wrong. The event this seat was underwritten for already fired as a rejection: the FDA issued a Complete Response Letter for the Anaphylm NDA on January 30, 2026, after the January 8-9, 2026 deficiency disclosure took the shares down more than 37% in one session. No FDA action date exists in 2026 at all. Everything now claimed as a catalyst is company-controlled and undated: the Q3 2026 resubmission is still unfiled and unannounced as of July 28, 2026 (SEC EDGAR shows no 8-K since June 10, 2026, which covered only annual-meeting votes, and the last company release was July 7, 2026, an investor-conference notice), and the August 2026 human-factors readout the file leans on is a consensus-calendar guess, not a company-scheduled event - management explicitly conditioned the data's availability on the FDA 'providing responses to our Human Factors protocol on time and the responses being within expectations,' which is a third party's unscheduled correspondence gating a voluntary disclosure. The binding answer is roughly H1 2027, two to three quarters outside the window. Beneath that there is no asset floor: at March 31, 2026 total liabilities of $175.2M exceeded total assets of $141.1M, leaving a stockholders' deficit of $(34.1)M, and the $110.7M of cash is not free - it sits against $133.6M of gross debt-like obligations, of which roughly $90M is royalty obligations ($26.9M) and liability related to the sale of future revenue ($63.1M) that are claims on the very revenue base the floor capitalises. The hidden disqualifier is that the financing floor is circular: per the May 12, 2026 Oaktree refinancing only $55M funded at closing, while $20M unlocks only UPON FDA APPROVAL of Anaphylm and a further $25M only on sales milestones - the capital that is supposed to fund the good case is unavailable in exactly the bad case, and the dilution plumbing is live (S-3 filed June 26, 2026, declared effective July 8, 424B3 filed July 9).
corrections: MATERIAL, five load-bearing items. (1) THE NEAR-WINDOW DATE IS NOT PRIMARY-SOURCED. The forcing_function and moderator_conclusion treat 'August 10, 2026, thirteen days away' as a dated event that earns pre-positioning. Independently checked against SEC EDGAR on July 28, 2026: the company has filed no 8-K since June 10, 2026 and issued no scheduling press release since July 7, 2026, so no Q2 report date is company-confirmed. Last quarter's confirming release came a week ahead (May 6 for a May 13 report); the equivalent notice has not appeared. The entire 'near window is now dated' upgrade rests on a third-party earnings calendar. (2) THE CATALYST FIRED, AND IT FIRED AS A REJECTION - confirmed at primary source. Company release of February 2, 2026 confirms the CRL was issued January 30, 2026, that it raised no safety, efficacy or manufacturing-quality concern, and that the FDA required a new human-factors validation study plus one PK study. Both must now succeed; the file's framing of a single gating readout understates it as two. Any seat premised on a 2026 FDA decision is premised on a date that does not exist. (3) DEBT LABEL IS MISLEADING THOUGH THE ARITHMETIC HOLDS. Verified against the March 31, 2026 balance sheet as published May 13, 2026: loans payable current $13.661M, notes payable net $25.099M, royalty obligations net $26.914M, liability related to sale of future revenue $1.000M current plus $62.083M non-current. Funded, recourse term debt is therefore about $38.8M net - against $110.7M of cash that is net CASH of roughly $72M on a funded-debt definition, not net debt of $22.8M. The bear's $133.6M / net-debt-$22.8M figure is only correct as a gross debt-like aggregate including the royalty and sold-future-revenue claims. Subtracting those from a revenue-multiple valuation is defensible (you cannot capitalise revenue that has been sold forward and ignore the claim), but the file states it as 'total debt,' which overstates recourse leverage and would mislead any reader testing solvency rather than equity value. The conclusion that there is no net cash floor survives; the label does not. (4) STALE CAPITAL STRUCTURE. All floor arithmetic uses the March 31, 2026 balance sheet, which predates the May 12, 2026 Oaktree refinancing that replaced the prior notes. Correct as filed, but not the structure as it stands today, and the file presents it as current. (5) FINANCING IS APPROVAL-GATED, SO IT LEVERS THE DOWNSIDE RATHER THAN FLOORING IT. The bull's condition that 'the launch is funded without punitive dilution' cannot be met in the rejection case: $45M of the headline $150M unlocks only on approval and sales milestones, and the shelf went effective July 8, 2026 into a stock roughly 49% below its 52-week high with weighted-average shares already up from 91.2M to 122.6M in five quarters. MINOR / IN FAIRNESS TO THE BULL, recorded so the kill is not overstated: the securities class action in the District of New Jersey (class period June 16, 2025 to January 8, 2026, lead-plaintiff deadline May 4, 2026, alleging management called the review 'on track' while concealing the human-factors deficiencies) is confirmed pending but is an allegation, not a finding, and follows near-automatically from a 37% one-day drop; the Q3 2026 resubmission guidance has been reaffirmed without amendment as recently as July 7, 2026; the FDA required no new efficacy trials; and the Oaktree maturity extension to 2031 genuinely removes any near-term maturity wall, so this is NOT a liquidity or going-concern kill. NOT VERIFIED: the S-3 filed June 26, 2026 could not be retrieved (SEC blocked the fetch), so whether it is a small resale registration or a primary universal shelf with ATM capacity is unconfirmed - its existence and effectiveness are confirmed from the EDGAR filing index, its size is not. The kill is the absence of a dated, binding event in the window and the absence of an asset floor, not insolvency.
evidence: Aquestive Therapeutics company press release, February 2, 2026 (GlobeNewswire / investors.aquestive.com), 'Aquestive Therapeutics Announces FDA Issuance of Complete Response Letter for Anaphylm': the FDA issued the CRL on January 30, 2026; it raised no concern on safety, efficacy or manufacturing quality, but cited human-factors and administration issues (difficulty opening the pouch, incorrect film placement) and labeling, and required a new human-factors validation study plus a single PK study; company targets resubmission 'as early as' Q3 2026. Confirms the catalyst fired as a rejection and that two studies, not one, gate the refiling.

Aquestive Therapeutics company press release, March 30, 2026 (GlobeNewswire), 'Announces Completion of Type A Meeting with FDA for Anaphylm': Type A meeting completed, clarifying FDA feedback on the PK and human-factors study designs, and resubmission guidance of Q3 2026 expressly conditioned on completion of the HF and PK studies AND 'typical response times from the FDA.' Confirms the refiling date is contingent and company-controlled, not a binding regulatory clock.

Aquestive Therapeutics Q1 2026 results release, May 13, 2026 (GlobeNewswire), condensed consolidated balance sheet at March 31, 2026: cash and cash equivalents $110.7M; total assets $141.125M; total liabilities $175.179M; total stockholders' deficit $(34.054)M; loans payable current $13.661M; notes payable net $25.099M; royalty obligations net $26.914M; liability related to sale of future revenue $1.000M current and $62.083M non-current; FY2026 revenue guidance $46-50M and adjusted EBITDA loss $(35)-$(30)M; new $150M Oaktree facility with principal not beginning until 2031 maturity, saving $45M of principal over three years. Confirms negative book equity, no net cash floor on a debt-like-obligations basis, and the exact composition the file mislabels as 'total debt.'

SEC EDGAR filing index for Aquestive Therapeutics, CIK 0001398733, retrieved July 28, 2026: most recent 8-K filed June 10, 2026 (annual-meeting voting results only); no 8-K or other filing disclosing an Anaphylm NDA resubmission, human-factors results, or a Q2 2026 earnings date; intervening filings are an S-3 filed June 26, 2026, an EFFECT notice dated July 8, 2026, a 424B3 filed July 9, 2026, an SC 13G/A on July 27, 2026, and Form 4 insider sales on June 9, June 12 (six filings), June 16, June 24 and July 17, 2026 with no offsetting purchases. Confirms the resubmission remains unfiled and unannounced with roughly nine weeks left in the guided quarter, that the August report date is not company-confirmed, and that shelf capacity is in place.
